sub_answers.text: Jiangxi Liansheng won the third-tier league and gained promotion to the second tier by beating Taiyuan Zhongyou Jiayi 2–0 in the division final after three seasons in the division.[d41907344s1p0] Darlington 1883 were crowned Northern League Division One champions in 2012–13 and thus gained promotion to the Northern Premier League Division One North for 2013–14.[d451159s4p0] Darlington achieved subsequent promotions by finishing as runners-up and winning play-offs, including winning the 2014–15 play-off final 2–0 against Bamber Bridge to earn promotion to the Premier Division.[d451159s4p0] Darlington were prevented from participating in a further promotion despite finishing in National League North play-off positions because ground grading issues blocked their participation, enforcing a non-performance criterion for upward movement.[d451159s4p0]
